within_player.context: high_school; legally confirmed Balanced freshmen, Average maturity, default family bodies
within_player.construction: BuilderService begin/raise/confirm; DevelopmentService grant/spend exact legal AP. Improvements are controlled interventions, not equal-resource Builder comparisons or predictions of natural opportunity.
within_player.counterbalance: Four slots per source-player cluster: home/open, away/open, away/not-open, home/not-open; each arm uses the same gameplay seed in its slot. Body, all teammates, opponent and role held fixed within a cluster.
within_player.secondary: scoring5 versus baseline FG%; all other metrics and all family strata descriptive
within_player.uncertainty: Paired source-player-cluster percentile bootstrap, 10000 deterministic resamples; each cluster retains all four slots and both arms. Ratio of pooled raw terms. Pointwise 95% and familywise 95% Bonferroni intervals over 7 primary outcomes x 2 ranges = 14. Sparse n=8 family strata are explicitly descriptive, not simultaneous hypothesis tests.
within_player.effect_interpretation: No locked minimum OVR-to-performance effect or all-observables win requirement exists. Report measured magnitudes, practical units, intervals and weakness/inversion causes; do not manufacture thresholds or pass/fail from correlations. Direction of basketball effects is empirical; only arithmetic monotonicity is an exact contract.

catalog_extension.population: unaltered competition-catalog-v4-roster-pairing; five competitions; synthetic calibration player population, no career ages or caps
catalog_extension.histogram: All 117 existing full-roster states x 10 players x five competitions, current OVR only; count each roster-state/player once. Descriptive finite fixture distribution, not mature-world rarity evidence.
catalog_extension.relationships: Player quartet aggregates, Pearson correlations and within-stratum demeaned correlations using direct basketball observables. Competition, position, tactical/rotation role, specialization, minutes and touches/opportunities. Cluster bootstrap by quartet/source population; tiny strata intervals flagged sparse. Aggregate correlations are not accepted as within-stratum relationships.

college_generation_extension.construction: Natural CareerSimulator paths with diagnostics; recorded college class snapshots (class index = roster index mod 3), original exact caps, original creation budget and source seed. Bodies resolved through canonical BodyMaturationService at chronological milestones 2 through snapshot career year from the original confirm stream. No selection on OVR or basketball outcome; arbitrary experimental rosters are not production roster evidence.
college_generation_extension.role_assignment: First five in each ten-player experimental roster start; remaining five rotate. Tactical role and nominal position use recorded family. Natural source draws retained; roster composition is an experimental choice.
college_generation_extension.interpretation: Descriptive college-age legal player evidence; two independent source populations per range is sparse and cannot establish roster representativeness.

natural_histograms.observations: Natural career starting current and exact-cap potential, college snapshots by age/class, peak and final current. No imposed peak path. Career peak/final are not contemporaneous active-world season samples.

untested: OVR guarantee across every role and matchup
exploration: No basketball output used to select frozen arms/ranges/sample. Smoke only validates executability and instruments and is separately labeled. Shared Builder exploration is not reused as confirmation.
